messages:
elaine.prod: Quick heads-up — I published the PRD draft for the new unified API contract (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank): https://redwood.atlassian.org/browse/PRD-4521. Please focus on acceptance criteria, backward compatibility, and edge cases.

samuel.pm: reading now. can we call out migration story for existing client libs explicitly? customers will ask about old params and behavior changes.

maria.eng: big one for eng: streaming semantics must be clearly defined. current chat stream yields partial deltas; completions stream is token stream. do we unify? pinging kyle-ml for rerank stream expectations.

kyle-ml: for rerank we don't stream scores. but we should support incremental ranking for long lists (pagination + partial results). also need explicit spec on score range/normalization so SDKs don't assume 0-1 vs raw logits.

toni-qa: edge cases I want called out in ACs: empty context + user-provided system message, truncated embeddings input (>512 tokens), partial failures when mix of model variants used (one fails, others succeed), and determinism checks for rerank with/without seed. we should list test vectors.

felix-ops: ops checklist: feature-flag gate, canary traffic to dedicated capacity, alert on 5xx rate > 0.5% and p95 latency regression > 20%. include rollout rollback playbook. also add required infra quota bump note for larger embedding batches.

elaine.prod: good points. Draft AC excerpt I added to the doc: ```Acceptance criteria:
- API supports dual-mode response: streaming (chat/completions) and non-streaming (embeddings, rerank) with clear Content-Type and event framing rules.
- Backwards compatibility shims for legacy params: `top_k`, `temperature` mapping table and deprecation timeline.
- Rerank response includes `raw_score`, `normalized_score` (0-1) and `model_version`.
- SDKs have migration guide and one-line opt-in flag for new contract.
- QA vectors: 6 named fixtures (empty prompt, long prompt, truncation, mixed model variants, partial-retry, high-throughput batching).
```

samuel.pm: nice. can we also include acceptance criteria around billing semantics? customers will query token billing for streaming vs non-streaming and rerank scoring costs.

maria.eng: +1 on billing. also add explicit error codes for cross-model fallbacks (e.g., MODEL_MISMATCH, FALLBACK_RATE_LIMIT). define retriable vs non-retriable responses.

kyle-ml: on normalization: recommend z-score only internally; expose min-max normalized [0,1] in API. doc should show deterministic example mapping. I'll upload a short snippet.

toni-qa: i'll start authoring the QA vectors and bring the first pass to test-sprint on tuesday. want to ensure we can automate rerank determinism checks in CI.

felix-ops: one more ops note: include requirement for trace ID propagation between frontend -> router -> model pool. we need that for incident triage when partial responses appear.

deploy-bot: PRD-4521 has been marked DRAFT -> REVIEW by elaine.prod at 2026-03-19T15:02:00Z. Please add reviewers in the doc.

elaine.prod: action items: (1) maria to propose streaming framing doc fragment by EOD, (2) kyle to attach normalization example, (3) samuel to add migration timeline and billing bullets, (4) toni to upload QA vectors. I'll consolidate into PRD and request formal sign-off by end of week. thanks all :thumbsup:
